description:
After core-exec-polars-cli-mcp-adoption, the core execution_engine setting routes every benchmark-query materialization on polars-df through polars_compat.collect_frame, and an AST guard enforces that for polars_df.py, expression_family.py and the Polars branches of unified_frame.py. Other Polars collects still bypass it:
- Timed write-primitive operations: benchbox/core/write_primitives/dataframe_operations.py ~L497 and ~L499 (timed from start_time at ~L419). A Write Primitives run with --execution-engine streaming records requested=streaming while these collects use Polars' default.
- Maintenance: benchbox/platforms/dataframe/polars_maintenance.py ~L60, 137, 148, 156, 205, 216, 231, 257, 278. Maintenance operations are built without an adapter (maintenance_interface.py ~L474-480), so the setting cannot reach them.
- Untimed paths: core/dataframe/benchmark_suite.py (compare-dataframes builds the adapter with no options), core/dataframe/profiling.py explain() without the engine, validation.py ~L216, equivalence/dataframe_surface.py ~L61, cross_surface.py ~L555.
Decide per path whether it follows the requested engine (timed paths should) and route it through collect_frame, or document the exclusion. Line numbers are from commit ecd08a9f0; re-read before editing.
